|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Darth Plagueis]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Darth Plagueis (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 2 February 2025: “Once per game, if drawn for destiny, may place this card out of play to make that destiny draw +6. Other Dark Jedi (except Sidious) are lost. While alone, your characters with 'Trade Federation' in lore deploy -1 to [Episode I] locations. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Darth Plagueis]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Darth Plagueis]] (published 26 December 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Darth Plagueis”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
